BiblicalUsage: Habaziniah means light of Jehovah, and he is named once, as the father of Jeremiah and the head of a Rechabite family. Jeremiah took his grandson Jaazaniah and the whole house of the Rechabites into the temple to test their vow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a father whose name means light of Jehovah, and whose children kept their vow, is worth remembering.
